specification.acquisitions: Archive source paragraphs and flags; no retrospectively optimized acquisition correction; static weights remain a limitation

specification.history: Original period releases preferred; reconcile rolling payment-fee tables to before minus fees equals after

specification.selection: Latest published peer period with positive calendar overlap and availability strictly before MUSA quarter-end
specification.target: US company-operated road transportation fuel margin BEFORE electronic-payment expenses; never broader US road-fuel margin
